verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents an Entitlements capability for deciding when to grant or revoke product feature access to customers, so the core concept exists. The only evidence is a single one-line doc mention, which supports little beyond that concept. Missing for 10: evidence that features are attached to products/plans, modeling of quantitative limits, a runtime API/SDK call to check a customer's active entitlements, entitlement-change events or webhooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
